lines.text: Notebook open, pencil ready. Let's see it!
Nice and tidy. Put it in the book!
Told you! I called that one!
Somebody check the tape, that can't be real!
Whoa! My pencil just snapped in half!
New page! That one gets its own page!
All five cards! Somebody laminate this page!
Perfect across the board! I'm not even surprised.
Hey, the notebook says that's still coming.
Close! I'm writing that down as almost.
Updating the notebook, the record book, and probably a mural somewhere!
Called it from the jump! Remember, I had you picked before the first dunk.
Rough one, but I've got a whole page saved for your rematch.
